provenance.notes: IEEE publishes its templates through the IEEE Template Selector (template-selector.ieee.org); the LaTeX class IEEEtran (CTAN, LPPL 1.3) supports IEEE transactions, journals and conferences. The class options, page size and fonts were NOT stated on the pages checked: they come from the IEEEtran documentation (IEEEtran_HOWTO.pdf) and must be checked there. Each conference also sets its own page limit and may override the template: follow its call for papers.

limits.text: Set by each conference. Check its call for papers.

anonymity.text: Depends on the conference: many IEEE conferences are single-blind.

facts.text: IEEE provides templates through the IEEE Template Selector.
IEEEtran is the IEEE class for transactions, journals and conferences (CTAN, v1.8b, LPPL 1.3).
Class option [conference], US Letter, two columns, Times 10 pt (from the IEEEtran documentation, not from the pages checked).

compile_check.tool: tectonic 0.17.0 (TeX bundle with the real class file)
compile_check.result: The generated main.tex compiled without errors on a real 15-page paper and rendered in two columns. This shows the class name and option are accepted; it does not show that the venue accepts the result.
